svg.title: Xbox Series X and S compatibility on Apple Silicon and Metal
svg.desc: All 58 tracked areas grouped into six subsystems. Foundation means bounded synthetic work; contract gap means unresolved Xbox requirements; open means no full acceptance. No area is certified complete for Xbox compatibility. The master document contains the accessible table.

g.text: Xbox Series X|S → Apple Silicon + Metal
58 tracked areas · comprehensive target · no full Xbox acceptance claimed

g.title: XBOX-01: Target profiles. Contract gap. Unknown contract; hardware research. Required: Separate Series X/S profiles; guest-visible CPU/GPU features, memory budgets, versions and capability queries; independently justified values

XBOX-02: Executable and module loading. Foundation. Bounded PE32+ foundation; interfaces; authentic loading open. Required: Actual supported Xbox executable/module formats, relocations, imports, initialization, TLS and dependencies; malformed-input handling and startup evidence

XBOX-03: Packages and content. Contract gap. Unknown contract; synthetic PE loading is not package compatibility. Required: Package metadata, mounts, install/update layout, resource lookup, content versions and supported input boundaries

XBOX-04: Process and calling conventions. Foundation. Bounded synthetic Win64 foundation; CPU registry. Required: Entry state, ABI, stack/unwind rules, register preservation, dynamic libraries, process lifecycle and exit behavior

XBOX-05: Integer CPU execution. Foundation. Bounded foundation; CPU registry. Required: Required x86-64 encodings, prefixes, flags, addressing, exceptions and boundary cases; interpreter/native translator agreement

XBOX-06: CPU floating point and SIMD. Foundation. Bounded foundation; full target coverage open. Required: Required x87/SSE/AVX and other vector forms; rounding, exceptions, NaNs, denormals, conversions and state save/restore

XBOX-07: CPU atomics and memory order. Open. Open; CPU boundary. Required: Atomic widths/alignment, locked operations, fences, cross-core visibility and contention; guest memory-order litmus tests on ARM64

XBOX-08: Translation lifecycle. Foundation. Bounded native translator foundation; full acceptance open. Required: Executable-page changes, self-modifying code, cache invalidation, code publication, interpreter/translator transitions and precise faults

XBOX-09: Virtual memory. Foundation. Bounded foundation; console contract open. Required: Guest page sizes, address-space layout, reservations, commits, protection, guard pages, faults, aliases and CPU/GPU mappings

XBOX-10: Threads and synchronization. Foundation. Bounded services; runtime registry. Required: Scheduling-visible behavior, TLS, events, waits, mutexes, semaphores, condition variables, wakeup ordering, cancellation and teardown
XBOX-11: Timing and exceptions. Foundation. Bounded services; console equivalence open. Required: Clock domains, timers, timeouts, exception delivery/unwind, asynchronous completion and error codes

XBOX-12: Graphics API/driver entry points. Contract gap. Unknown contract; GDK research. Required: Enumerate actual Xbox exports, signatures, structures, ownership, callbacks, errors and version differences

XBOX-13: Command submission. Foundation. Synthetic command/graph foundation; console packets unknown. Required: Actual command streams or applicable interception interface; graphics/compute/copy work, ordering, queues, synchronization and recovery

XBOX-14: Shader/pipeline containers. Contract gap. Unknown console layout; container research. Required: Validate actual payloads, shader extraction, stage metadata, pipeline serialization and versioning; establish code versus data boundaries
XBOX-15: Shader entry ABI. Contract gap. Synthetic ABI only; interfaces. Required: Registers, stage inputs/outputs, wave state, descriptors, constants, built-ins and guest GPU address rules

XBOX-16: Resource creation and lifetime. Foundation. Bounded S2 foundation; integrated acceptance. Required: Buffers/textures, heaps, allocation alignment, aliasing, residency, ownership, destruction with in-flight use and failure atomicity

XBOX-17: Formats and layouts. Foundation. Finite format matrix; console layout open. Required: Complete target format/role matrix, compression, packing, tiling/swizzles, pitches, mips, slices, samples and reinterpretation

XBOX-18: Resource views. Foundation. Bounded S2.4; full console coverage open. Required: SRV/UAV/attachment-equivalent behavior, ranges, reinterpretation, arrays, cubes, 3D, depth/stencil aspects and overlap

XBOX-19: Descriptors and binding. Foundation. Bounded S2.5; descriptor tables; console layouts unknown. Required: Actual heap/table/root binding contracts, dynamic indexing, address and lifetime rules, null descriptors and bounds

XBOX-20: Uploads, copies and readback. Foundation. Bounded S2.2/S2.3; full matrix open. Required: All required transfer directions, subresources, conversions, overlap rules and observable untouched data

XBOX-21: Coherence and barriers. Foundation. Bounded explicit mirrors/graphs; console semantics open. Required: CPU/GPU visibility, caches, resource transitions, UAV/alias barriers, ownership and completion/error propagation
XBOX-22: Sparse and streamed resources. Open. Open. Required: Tiled/sparse mappings, residency changes, sampler-feedback interactions, eviction and failure behavior where required
XBOX-23: Indirect work and queries. Open. Open beyond bounded foundations. Required: Indirect draw/dispatch, counters, predicates, timestamps, occlusion/statistics and observable ordering

XBOX-24: Instruction identities. Foundation. Full desktop checklist; console completeness unknown. Required: Every required console encoding; reconcile desktop inventory with actual target differences

XBOX-25: Operands and modifiers. Foundation. Partial contracts; a decoded mnemonic does not close this row. Required: Source classes, literals, register pairs, aliasing, width/packing, clamps, swizzles, DPP/SDWA and special registers where applicable
XBOX-26: Arithmetic and conversions. Foundation. S3.1 in progress; checkpoints. Required: Required integer/FP16/FP32/FP64/packed/mixed forms, conversions and bit operations across applicable stages
XBOX-27: Control flow. Foundation. Bounded scalar/graphics paths; S3.2 open. Required: Branches, loops, calls, dynamic paths, reconvergence, termination and instruction-boundary validation
XBOX-28: Predicates, masks and flags. Foundation. Partial subset; S3.3 open. Required: SCC/VCC/EXEC behavior, inactive lanes, conditional writes, carries, comparisons, divergence and helper lanes

XBOX-29: Wave and lane behavior. Foundation. Wave32 synthetic subset; S3.4 open. Required: Target wave sizes, lane numbering, shuffles, ballots, reductions, quad operations and cross-lane dependencies
XBOX-30: Shader memory. Foundation. Bounded memory subset; S3.5 open. Required: Buffer/image loads/stores, address spaces, bounds, atomics, LDS/shared memory, barriers and ordering

XBOX-31: Sampling. Foundation. Selected 2D/array paths; full matrix open. Required: Texture dimensions/formats, samplers, addressing, filtering, LOD/gradients, gather, comparison, anisotropy and edge semantics

XBOX-32: Numerical equivalence. Foundation. Restricted evidence; S3.6 open. Required: NaN/Inf/signed zero, denormals, rounding, precision, overflow, fused operations, contraction and transcendental requirements

XBOX-33: Shader stages. Foundation. Bounded vertex/pixel/compute foundation; broader stages open. Required: All target stages and their linkage, interpolation, built-ins and stream/output rules; geometry/tessellation/mesh/task-equivalent paths where required

XBOX-34: Rasterization and output. Foundation. Bounded S1 foundation; console-wide acceptance open. Required: Topologies, clipping/culling, viewport/scissor, provoking/interpolation rules, depth/stencil, blending, MRT and sample behavior
XBOX-35: Multisampling and precision. Open. Open. Required: Sample patterns, coverage, sample-frequency shading, resolves, depth/stencil resolves and format precision

XBOX-36: Ray tracing. Open. Open; host mapping must be proven, not inferred from Metal feature names. Required: Pipeline and inline-query interfaces, acceleration structures/build/update, traversal, hit/miss behavior and synchronization
XBOX-37: Variable-rate shading. Open. Open. Required: Required rate images, combiners, coverage and derivative interactions; exact target-to-host mapping

XBOX-38: Advanced bindings and execution. Foundation. Bounded indexing/cache foundations; broader behavior open. Required: Required bindless/resource indexing, mesh-driven/indirect GPU work, pipeline caching and capability reporting

XBOX-39: Presentation. Open. Offscreen synthetic validation does not certify presentation. Required: Swapchain-equivalent behavior, pacing, buffering, vsync/VRR, color spaces/HDR, resizing, focus and device loss

XBOX-40: Host compatibility. Foundation. Runtime gating foundations; full host matrix open. Required: Per-chip/OS Metal capability matrix, correct fallback paths, limits, compiler behavior and recovery; native ARM64 dependency audit

XBOX-41: Runtime/system services. Foundation. Synthetic service registry and inventory; console completeness unknown. Required: Enumerate actual imports and guest-visible contracts, handles, strings, errors, callbacks and asynchronous behavior
XBOX-42: Filesystem and save data. Open. Full Xbox contract open. Required: Paths, mounts, permissions, file/directory operations, async I/O, persistent saves, quotas and failure handling

XBOX-43: Streaming and decompression. Open. Open; Velocity Architecture disclosure alone is not an interface spec. Required: Storage request interfaces, completion ordering, required codecs/data formats, cancellations and resource-streaming integration
XBOX-44: Audio. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Target APIs, codecs, channel layouts, mixing, resampling, spatial audio, clocks/latency and device changes

XBOX-45: Input and peripherals. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Controllers, hotplug, mappings, rumble, trigger feedback, keyboard/mouse/accessibility and polling/timestamp semantics where exposed
XBOX-46: Video and media. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Required decode/playback APIs, codecs, A/V synchronization, subtitles and surface sharing
XBOX-47: Networking. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Sockets/transports, name resolution, asynchronous I/O, timing, disconnect/error semantics and title-specific dependencies

XBOX-48: Identity and online services. Contract gap. Unknown/externally dependent; offline success cannot certify online compatibility. Required: Guest-visible users, authentication-dependent APIs, multiplayer, achievements, cloud saves and unavailable-service behavior
XBOX-49: Lifecycle and suspend/resume. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Launch/exit, focus, suspend/resume, device changes, retained state and Quick Resume-related observable requirements
XBOX-50: Locale, accessibility and settings. Open. Full Xbox acceptance open. Required: Language/region, text/Unicode, time zone, accessibility, display/audio settings and configuration changes

XBOX-51: Installation and updates. Contract gap. Unknown contract; do not infer from PC packaging. Required: Content/DLC discovery, versions, deployment/update behavior and title-specific dependencies

XBOX-52: Firmware and system environment. Contract gap. Research unresolved; no firmware/dashboard compatibility claim. Required: Determine necessary kernel/system interfaces, privileged operations and any full-boot requirements; record unavailable dependencies

g.text: Evidence that the whole system works

g.title: XBOX-53: Per-feature acceptance. Foundation. Existing synthetic acceptance practice; extend to all requirements. Required: Versioned contract, applicable targets/hosts, implementation paths, independent oracle, boundary/negative tests, native execution, limitations and review

XBOX-54: Original integrated workloads. Foundation. Bounded original workloads; synthetic integration. Required: Sustained CPU + graphics + resources + input + audio + storage execution; concurrency, teardown and failure recovery

XBOX-55: Per-title compatibility. Open. Commercial game execution not demonstrated. Required: Record load, startup, first frame, interaction, gameplay, save/load, audio/input and sustained stability separately, for each title/version and target

XBOX-56: Performance and stability. Foundation. Bounded benchmarks only; no general playability claim. Required: Frame-time distributions, shader/CPU compilation, memory growth, caches, streaming stalls, latency, long sessions and reproducible host configuration

XBOX-57: Diagnostics and packaging. Foundation. Research tools exist; end-user compatibility workflow open. Required: Reproducible launches, precise unsupported-feature reports, crash diagnostics, validation tooling, native packaging and installation

XBOX-58: Inventory closure. Open. Open; this map starts the system-wide ledger, not its certification. Required: Reconcile every discovered interface/form/mode with a requirement and evidence row; audit missing categories and untracked behavior

g.text: Foundation ≠ console compatibility. Every area still needs Xbox-specific acceptance.
Source: docs/xbox-compatibility.md · Desktop RDNA2 instruction coverage is a separate, narrower inventory.
